summary: Sunshine Biopharma Inc. filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for an at-the-market offering of up to $4,000,000 of common stock under an existing shelf registration. Aegis Capital Corp. acts as sales agent on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, earning a 3.0% commission. Sales will be made in at-the-market offerings, with no escrow arrangement. The filing is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
